reviews.title: OpenAI review
reviews.pros: Ease my tasks as a PhD student, especially guiding me in all my writing to go perfect and accept my supervisors.
reviews.cons: Not well trained and needs further work to be done.
reviews.overall: Very good and is a life easing bot that I plan to use in my daily writing activities that are critical to my writing.

reviews.title: Really amazing
reviews.pros:
OpenAI and their products GPT-3 and ChatGPT really are amazing. These are the breakthrough AI solutions we have been waiting for, and the beginning of the AI revolution.

You can ask it almost anything and it will give you a detailed and coherent answer, whether its text or math, or images in the case of DALL-E 2.

They also offer an extensible API.
reviews.cons: It tip toes around certain politically charged topics.
reviews.overall: OpenAI is an unbelievable leap forward in the field of AI. I am excited to see the uses that people find for their language models.

reviews.title: Better than any other AI
reviews.pros: Everything about it except for the cons.
reviews.cons: Couldn't browse the internet to get information.
reviews.overall: It can answer basically any question!
